name: -6 AN Male to Male Gauge Adapter w/ 1/8" NPT Port
title: -6 AN Male to Male Gauge Adapter w/ 1/8" NPT Port
description:
The -6 AN Male to Male Gauge Adapter w/ 1/8" NPT Port is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Male to Male Gauge Adapter Fittings are precision-engineered to provide an inline 1/8" NPT side port for connecting a pressure or temperature sensor directly into your plumbing line, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering plumbing systems.

Each adapter is CNC machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process for maximum strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. These fittings are designed to withstand high pressure and high temperature environments commonly found in racing, street performance, marine, and aviation applications.

their AN Male to Male Gauge Adapter Fittings are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with their nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these adapters deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance plumbing system.

For best installation results, the manufacturer strongly recommend using their AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference their installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Thread Pitch: Precision NPT tapered threads for leak-free sealing in blocks and cells.
